napping.text: Zzz… ({name} is napping. It will wake soon.)

last_day.text: Tomorrow I'll go home. Let's make today a really good one.

stay_more.text: I can stay a little longer. A few more days. Then I really should go live my wild life.

hug_more.text: (A big, warm hug.) Mmm. Okay, one more is allowed.
(Squeeze!) That one was the best one yet.

gift_ask.text: Before I go… can I take something with you-smell on it? Something to remember.

gift_got.text: The {gift}! I'll keep it forever. FOREVER.

goodbye_ask.text: How do you want to say goodbye?

farewell.text: ({name} {trust}.) I'm so excited and a tiny bit sad, both at once. You helped me grow strong. Thank you, {child}.

release_invite.text: {name} walks to the edge of the meadow and looks back at you.

release_forced.text: It's time. {name} walks to the edge of the meadow and looks back at you, happy.

first_gift.text: {name} gives you a {treasure} it was saving. "For you. Keep it safe."

favplace.text: {name} shows you its {place}. Naps there are extra cozy now.

a.say: Can I ask you something? How was your day today?

choices.label: Good!
choices.reply: Good days are the best kind. Tell me one good thing? …Actually, just smiling is fine too.

choices.label: Okay
choices.reply: Okay days are allowed. They're like plain toast. Still toast.

choices.label: Not great
choices.reply: Oh. Then I'll sit right here with you. You don't have to say anything.

choices.label: Just sit
choices.reply: (It settles in beside you, warm and quiet.)

good.say: Should we save today in the Memory Book?

choices.label: Yes!
choices.memory: You had a really good day, and you told me

choices.label: No need
choices.reply: Okay. I'll just remember it in my head.

okay.say: Want to do something fun together after this?

choices.label: Play
choices.reply: Yes! Tap Play whenever you want.

hard2.say: I'm really glad you're here with me.
hard2.memory: One day you felt not great, and we sat together
